context.dating_note: Start year 1890 is the colony's formal establishment on 1 January 1890 (EEBC2002 p.104). GHA VII p.268 ('By the end of 1889 they had occupied...') dates the Italian occupation, a separate event.
context.control_limits_en: 1890–1941: Colony proclaimed 1890 (OHM start_date 1890-01-01). Limits with Ethiopia fixed by Italo-Ethiopian treaties 1900/1902/1908 (the EEBC 2002 mandate was to delimit on these treaties – EEBC2002; treaty texts themselves not read). | 1941–1952: British administration from 1941 (OHM start 1941-11-27) until federation. | 1952–1962: Federation under the Ethiopian Crown per UNGA 390 (V) A of 2 Dec 1950; in force 1952. | 1962–1993: Federation dissolved 1962 (OHM end 1962); armed struggle 1961–91; EPLF took Asmara May 1991 [VERIFY date source]; de facto control not traced. | 1993–2026: Independence 1993 after UN-observed referendum (OHM 2803445 start 1993). Sudan–Eritrea border unchanged from colonial line.
